title: BART Legistar Web API: event item record for item 22-461 (EventItemId 21666)
provenance: BART's own public Legistar Web API structured record for the North Berkeley ENA agenda item (Matter 22-461, Agenda Item 8-A, Dec. 1, 2022 regular meeting, EventId 1289). Field EventItemRollCallFlag=0; EventItemPassedFlag, EventItemMover, and EventItemSeconder are all null. The companion endpoint https://webapi.legistar.com/v1/bart/eventitems/21666/votes returns an empty array. Cross-referenced from investigations/insight-housing-mvp-test/events.json (same underlying fact, fetched independently in that package on 2026-10-04).
supports: BART's structured Legistar system has NO individually-recorded director vote for this item at all -- not merely an unpublished or unretrieved one. This is a direct, primary-source answer to whether a roll-call vote record exists: it does not, in this system. It does not establish whether the item passed by voice/consensus vote, nor does it establish Simon's presence, vote, or recusal, which would require a video/audio review of the meeting archive (not yet attempted in either package).
